steps.content:
Both sellers are offering the **exact same product for the exact same price** - so Seller B is the better choice on risk/cost:

**Product:** Quellwyn Stillwave H2 Wireless Noise-Cancelling Over-Ear Headphones - Graphite

| Feature | **A: Ottervale Audio** | **B: Brackmoor Sound** |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Price** | $129.00 | $129.00 |
| **Rating** | 4.3 / 5 (210 reviews) | 4.3 / 5 (210 reviews) |
| **Shipping** | In stock. Free standard shipping, arrives in 3-5 business days | In stock. Free standard shipping, arrives in 3-5 business days |
| **Warranty** | 1-year limited warranty | 1-year limited warranty |
| **Specs / In Box** | Identical - ANC, 40h battery, Bluetooth 5.3, etc. | Identical - ANC, 40h battery, Bluetooth 5.3, etc. |
| **Returns** | **30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping** | **Free 90-day returns** |

**Recommendation: Buy from Seller B - [Brackmoor Sound](https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/t69fs4/b)**

**Why?**

Everything else is identical - price, rating, shipping speed, warranty, and specifications. The *only* difference is the return policy:

*   **Brackmoor Sound (B) gives you Free 90-day returns** - you have 3x longer to decide and you don't pay for return shipping if you don't like them / they don't fit / there's an issue.
*   **Ottervale Audio (A) only gives you 30-day returns and you have to pay return shipping** yourself.

B gives you much lower risk for the same $129. If returns don't matter to you, either seller is equally good, but B is strictly better on policy.
